item.title: Louis F. Angotti, 81

item.title: Jacqueline B. Miller, 62

item.title: Winter weather advisory for snow in effect Saturday afternoon until 5 o’clock
item.description: Snow accumulations of 3 to 5 inches are now forecast this afternoon, with 6 to 9 inches possible across eastern portions of the twin forks.

item.title: Frigid temps, blowing winds, drifting snow: ‘This one was a crippling storm’
item.description: Snow drifts of more than 7 ft. on some roads caused about 50 vehicles to become stranded and requiring rescue last night, Riverhead Highway Supt. Mike Zaleski said.

item.title: Calverton mixed-use project gains preliminary site plan approval
item.description: Planning Board wrap up: preliminary OK for 'Calverton Hamlet Center' on Rt. 25; 33-lot sketch plan approved for Laurel subdivision; more.

item.title: Riverhead and two other towns sue state over cannabis rules and local control
item.description: Riverhead, Southampton and Brookhaven sued New York, saying state cannabis regulators are illegally overriding local control over where retail marijuana shops can locate.

item.title: Bondholders sue Triple Five affiliate and NJ municipality, claiming collusion to cut megamall’s PILOT payments
item.description: Alleged collusion by Triple Five’s American Dream megamall and New Jersey town puts repayment of $800 million in bonds at risk: lawsuit claims.

item.title: Walmart to open supercenter at its current Riverhead location
item.description: Walmart plans to convert its Riverhead store into a 180,000-square-foot supercenter with a full-service supermarket and a discount department store.
